meta.title: Software development and IT support for business — ArtIntelliCo
meta.description: ArtIntelliCo builds IT solutions: e-commerce, portals, SaaS, machine learning, artificial intelligence and ongoing technical support.

hero.title: We build IT solutions that work for your business
hero.text: The ArtIntelliCo team helps you digitalise and automate business processes by designing and delivering modern IT solutions.

services.heading: How we can help
services.lead: We don't tie ourselves to one programming language or platform: we work out the problem first, then pick the tools. Sometimes the best answer is an off-the-shelf subscription service, and then we'll say so.

concept.title: IT solution concept
concept.text: We work out what the system actually has to do and turn it into requirements that both the business and the developers can work from.
concept.details: The most expensive mistake in an IT project happens before the first line of code: the system gets built for a problem nobody properly defined. So we start by talking to the people who'll use it — accounting, the warehouse, sales managers — not just the person signing off. Sometimes our conclusion is to build nothing and configure an existing product instead. That counts as a result too.
includes: interviews with staff and a walkthrough of current processes
business requirements and user scenarios
a comparison of ready-made products against custom development
a specification with time and budget estimates per phase
concept.result: A document any team, ours or someone else's, can estimate from and start building.

saas.title: SaaS development
saas.text: We design and build SaaS platforms, from a first version for pilot customers to a service where every customer has their own workspace, plan and dashboard.
saas.details: In SaaS the money isn't in the code. It's in how easily a new customer can sign up, pay and get going without calling support. We build in multi-tenancy, billing and permissions from day one, because retrofitting them once customers are inside costs several times more. And we try to ship the first version early: real users are quick to show which features were never needed.
includes: multi-tenant architecture with isolated customer data
sign-up, plans, subscriptions and online payments
customer dashboards, roles and permissions
integrations and a public API for your customers
scaling as load grows
saas.result: A product you can sell by subscription, not a project you have to roll out by hand every time.

web.title: Web development
web.text: Corporate websites, marketplaces, online stores, booking systems and internal web tools, built around the task rather than a template.
web.details: A business website is judged by leads and orders, not by how it looks in a portfolio. So we agree up front on what counts as a result and set up analytics before launch, not six months later. The technology follows the task: a landing page doesn't need a heavy platform, and a marketplace won't fit into a website builder.
includes: prototype and interface design
frontend, backend and admin panel
integrations with payments, delivery, CRM and accounting systems
SEO groundwork, page speed and analytics
launch and ongoing support
web.result: A web service where you can see how many leads and how much revenue it brings in.

mobile.title: Mobile apps
mobile.text: iOS and Android apps, together with the server side and the admin panel behind them.
mobile.details: An app makes sense when customers come back to it regularly: reordering, tracking a delivery, collecting loyalty points. If someone visits once a year, a good mobile website is cheaper, and we'll tell you that before any work starts. Native or cross-platform is decided by budget and by how much the app relies on the camera, location and offline mode.
includes: iOS and Android apps
server side and API
an admin panel for content, orders and users
push notifications and analytics
publishing to the App Store and Google Play
mobile.result: An app that passes store review and that your team can run without calling a developer.

ai.title: AI-powered solutions
ai.text: We offer solutions built on artificial intelligence and machine learning that automate your business processes with AI agents.
ai.details: We're more sceptical about AI than most: half of the "let's add a neural network" ideas are solved by ordinary automation. But where people spend hours sorting emails, documents and support requests, language models genuinely take the routine off their plate. We start with a pilot on your own data, so you see accuracy figures before the main build rather than after it.
includes: AI agents that handle routine process steps on their own: triaging requests, filling in the CRM, drafting replies to customers
chatbots and assistants for customers and staff
document recognition and data extraction
request classification and knowledge-base search
demand forecasting and data analysis
a pilot with quality measured on your data
ai.result: A specific process that people used to do by hand, now done by the system, with a person still in control.

crm.title: CRM and ERP development
crm.text: Custom CRM and ERP systems built around the way your business works, not the other way round.
crm.details: Off-the-shelf CRM is fine as long as your process looks standard. When managers run half their work in spreadsheets because the system "can't do that", building your own becomes cheaper. We migrate data from old systems and spreadsheets and roll out department by department, so work never stops for a day.
includes: sales, warehouse, production and finance modules, as needed
roles, permissions and an audit log
reports and dashboards for management
data migration from spreadsheets and legacy systems
integration with accounting, telephony and email
crm.result: One system instead of a zoo of spreadsheets: management sees where things stand without weekly reports from every department.

cloud.title: Cloud solutions
cloud.text: We move your infrastructure, in full or in part, to Amazon Web Services and make sure it keeps running and doesn't get more expensive for no reason.
cloud.details: The cloud isn't always cheaper than your own server. It pays off when load spikes, when you need fault tolerance, or when new environments should come up in minutes rather than a week. So a migration starts with an audit and a cost estimate, and the move happens in stages, with a rollback plan at every step.
includes: audit of the current infrastructure and a cost estimate
AWS architecture and a migration plan
moving servers, databases and files
backups and monitoring
cost optimisation after the move
cloud.result: Infrastructure that survives a server failure, and a cloud bill you actually understand.

redhat.title: Company infrastructure on Red Hat
redhat.text: We build your company's IT infrastructure on Red Hat: servers on Red Hat Enterprise Linux, the OpenShift container platform and automation with Ansible.
redhat.details: Companies pick Red Hat when infrastructure has to run for years and pass audits, rather than live in one administrator's head. The subscription pays for itself through vendor support and a long lifecycle: Red Hat Enterprise Linux is supported for ten years. We design the infrastructure around your workloads and describe server configuration in Ansible, so any machine can be rebuilt from a playbook instead of from memory. Red Hat is our partner, so we can also help you sort out subscriptions and vendor support.
includes: audit of your current servers and a migration plan
Red Hat Enterprise Linux rollout with centralised updates through Red Hat Satellite
the OpenShift container platform for your applications
configuration and deployment automation with Ansible
central identity and access management (Identity Management)
monitoring, backups and documentation for your team
redhat.result: Infrastructure you can audit, reproduce and hand over to another team without losing what it knows.

api.title: APIs and integrations
api.text: We design APIs for your systems and connect them with the services you already use.
api.details: The most common pain we see is data typed in twice. Orders from the website re-entered into the accounting system by hand, payments reconciled in a spreadsheet. An integration removes that work and the mistakes that come with it. We also set up monitoring, because integrations break quietly when a partner changes their API, and it's better to hear about it from the system than from a customer.
includes: API design and documentation
integrations with payment providers, delivery services, CRM and accounting
data exchange between internal systems
queues and retries when something fails
monitoring and alerts
api.result: Data is entered once and gets where it needs to go on its own.

support.title: Technical support
support.text: We keep your systems running and keep improving them, including ones we didn't build.
support.details: Support is more than fixing bugs. It's updates that close security holes, monitoring that spots a problem before users do, and small improvements along the way. If the system came from another contractor, we start with an audit and documentation: without it, every change is a gamble.
includes: availability and error monitoring
bug fixes and security updates
backups and restore testing
planned improvements and new features
audit and documentation of systems built by other contractors
support.result: A system that works, and a team that knows how it's put together.

contacts.heading: Tell us about your project
contacts.text: If you have a partnership proposal or want to know more about our solutions and experience — drop us an email.

footer.slogan: We saw IT being born. We know how it works today — and we understand where it is heading tomorrow.
